2023_084_11_a_rfp_9951tsd_2023_athletics.paragraph: Agenda item 11.A. for the January 17, 2023 Troy School District Board of Education meeting consists of a January 5, 2023 letter of recommendation from Foresite Design of Berkley, Michigan, addressed to Rob Carson, together with the bid tabulation sheets for RFP 9951TSD, the 2023 Synthetic Turf and Track Renovations at Troy High School and Boulan Park Middle School. Bids were opened December 15, 2022 across four trade categories, drawing twelve bids in all. **Item and source**
Board agenda item 11.A., meeting of January 17, 2023: "RFP 9951TSD 2023 Athletics Letter of Rec 230105." The packet contains a letter dated January 5, 2023 from Foresite Design (3269 Coolidge Highway, Berkley, Michigan 48072; phone 248-547-7757; www.foresitedesign.com), signed by Michael Sims, addressed to Rob Carson, Troy School District, 4400 Livernois Road, Troy, MI 48098. Subject: Troy High School & Boulan Park Middle School, 2023 Synthetic Turf and Track Renovations, Letter of Recommendation. Copies to Larry Franckowiak of Troy School District; Michelle Kerns/Mark Paulus of Lecole Planners; and the FDI file. One enclosure — the bid tabulation.

**Bidding process**
Bids were submitted December 15, 2022 (bids due 12/15/22 at 11:00 A.M.). The project was separated into four trade categories, and a total of twelve bids were received. Post-bid interviews with the apparent low bidders were conducted on December 16, 2022 and January 3, 2023. Tabulation sheets are dated 12/16/2022 and track bid security, Iran sanction disclosure, familial disclosure, Addendum #1 acknowledgment, base bid, and remarks.

**Recommended awards**

| Proposal | Recommended contractor | Location | Contract sum |
|---|---|---|---|
| A — Site Work | S&H Trucking and Excavating | Fort Gratiot, Michigan | $483,000.00 |
| B — Synthetic Turf | Shaw Integrated and Turf Solutions, Inc. | Dalton, Georgia | $580,458.00 |
| C — Track Surface | Goddard Coatings Company | Pontiac, Michigan | $144,105.00 |
| D — Site Work Track | Nagle Paving Company | Novi, Michigan | $534,790.00 |
| | | **Total** | **$1,742,353.00** |

**Breakdowns and alternates**
Proposal A: base bid $343,000.00 plus Voluntary Alternate No. 1 at $140,000.00, total $483,000.00. The alternate covers complete removal of the existing E-layer and its replacement with a pre-manufactured performance pad carrying a 24-year warranty, described as adding benefits for safety, athlete performance, and maintenance.
Proposal B: base bid $515,905.00 plus Voluntary Alternate No. 1 at $64,553.00, total $580,458.00. The alternate substitutes the proprietary "GameOn" turf system for the base bid; over 90% of the inlays are fully tufted, yielding a more consistent playing surface and reduced maintenance.
Proposal C: the letter cites a contract sum of $194,105.00 and shows base bid $194,105.00 with Voluntary Alternate No. 1 at $-50,000.00 for a total of $144,105.00. Accepting S&H's Voluntary Alternate #1 reduces Goddard's scope by eliminating the new E-layer work; Goddard offered a $50,000.00 credit, which Foresite deems fair value.
Proposal D: base bid $534,790.00, total $534,790.00.

**Bid tabulation (base bids)**
Proposal A — Site Work Turf: S&H Trucking & Excavating $343,000.00 (Vol Alt 1); Gibraltar Construction Company $487,400.00; Eagle Excavation Incorporated $770,000.00.
Proposal B — Synthetic Turf: Sprinturf $460,440.00 (Vol Alt 1); Astroturf Great Lakes $462,365.00 (Vol Alt 2); A-Turf, Inc. $477,500.00 (Vol Alt 1); Shaw Integrated Turf Solutions $515,905.00 (Vol Alt 1); Act Global Americas, Inc. $529,927.00.
Proposal C — Track Surface: Goddard Coatings Company $194,105.00; Star Trac Enterprise, LLC $282,000.00.
Proposal D — Site Work Track: Nagle Paving Company $534,790.00; Asphalt Specialists, LLC $750,000.00.

Foresite asks the district to advise what additional information may be required from the recommended contractors so it can be secured for presentation at the next Board of Education meeting.
2023_084_11_a_rfp_9951tsd_2023_athletics.verbose:
**Identification**
This packet is Board of Education agenda item 11.A. for the Troy School District meeting of January 17, 2023, titled "RFP 9951TSD 2023 Athletics Letter of Rec 230105." It comprises a two-page letter of recommendation dated January 5, 2023 and its single enclosure, a four-page bid tabulation. The letter is on the letterhead of Foresite Design, 3269 Coolidge Highway, Berkley, Michigan 48072, phone 248-547-7757, website www.foresitedesign.com, with the practice areas footer "Athletic Facility Planning – Site Planning – Consulting – Landscape Architecture." It is addressed to Rob Carson, Troy School District, 4400 Livernois Road, Troy, MI 48098, and signed by Michael Sims (initials MDS). The subject line reads: "Troy School District – Troy High School & Boulan Park Middle School – 2023 Synthetic Turf and Track Renovations – Letter of Recommendation." One enclosure is noted. Copies were sent to Larry Franckowiak of Troy School District; Michelle Kerns and Mark Paulus of Lecole Planners; and the FDI file.

**Procurement history**
Bids for the Troy School District 2023 Synthetic Turf and Track Renovations project were submitted on December 15, 2022; the tabulation sheets record the bid deadline as 12/15/22 at 11:00 A.M. The project was separated into four trade categories — Proposal A Site Work (Site Work Turf), Proposal B Synthetic Turf, Proposal C Track Surface, and Proposal D Site Work Track — and a total of twelve bids were received across them. Post-bid interviews were conducted with the apparent low bidders on December 16, 2022 and again on January 3, 2023. The enclosed tabulation sheets are each dated 12/16/2022 and are headed "Troy School District 2023 / Troy High School Turf Track / Boulan Park MS Track." Each sheet carries columns for bid security, Iran sanction disclosure, familial disclosure, Addendum #1 acknowledgment, base bid, and remarks, with the note "**Bold Indicates Apparent Low Bidder."

**Proposal A – Site Work**
Foresite recommends S&H Trucking and Excavating of Fort Gratiot, Michigan to complete the work identified in Proposal A Site Work for a contract sum of $483,000.00. The breakdown is: Proposal A Base Bid $343,000.00; Voluntary Alternate No. 1 $140,000.00; Total $483,000.00. The recommended sum is based on acceptance of one voluntary alternate, which includes the complete removal of the existing E-layer and its replacement with a pre-manufactured performance pad. The new performance pad carries a 24-year warranty and, per the letter, would provide added benefits toward safety, athlete performance, and maintenance.

**Proposal B – Synthetic Turf**
Foresite recommends Shaw Integrated and Turf Solutions, Inc. of Dalton, Georgia to complete the work identified in Proposal B Synthetic Turf for a contract sum of $580,458.00. The breakdown is: Proposal B Base Bid $515,905.00; Voluntary Alternate No. 1 $64,553.00; Total $580,458.00. The recommended sum is based on acceptance of one voluntary alternate implementing the proprietary "GameOn" turf system in lieu of the base bid. The letter states the technology of this turf system allows for over 90% of the inlays to be fully tufted, providing a consistent playing surface as well as reduced maintenance efforts and expenses. Shaw's base bid was not the lowest of the five base bids listed on the Proposal B tabulation.

**Proposal C – Track Surface**
Foresite recommends Goddard Coatings Company of Pontiac, Michigan to complete the work identified in Proposal C Track Surface, citing a contract sum of $194,105.00 in the narrative. The breakdown shown is: Proposal C Base Bid $194,105.00; Voluntary Alternate No. 1 $-50,000.00; Total $144,105.00. The letter explains that by recommending acceptance of Voluntary Alternate #1 from S&H Trucking & Excavating, Goddard Coatings Company's scope of work will be reduced to eliminate the new E-layer work. During post-bid evaluations Goddard Coatings Company offered a credit of $50,000.00 for the reduced scope, which Foresite's office deems to be of fair value.

**Proposal D – Site Work Track**
Foresite recommends Nagle Paving Company of Novi, Michigan to complete the work identified in Proposal D Site Work Track for a contract sum of $534,790.00. The breakdown is: Proposal D Base Bid $534,790.00; Total $534,790.00. No alternates are applied to this proposal.

**Total recommended award**
The letter summarizes the total amount recommended for award as: S&H Trucking and Excavating $483,000.00; Shaw Integrated and Turf Solutions, Inc. $580,458.00; Goddard Coatings Company $144,105.00; Nagle Paving Company $534,790.00; Total $1,742,353.00.

**Bid tabulation – Proposal A, Site Work Turf**
Three base bids are recorded: S&H Trucking & Excavating $343,000.00, with the remark "Vol Alt (1)"; Gibraltar Construction Company $487,400.00; and Eagle Excavation Incorporated $770,000.00. Four additional bidder rows are blank.

**Bid tabulation – Proposal B, Synthetic Turf**
Five base bids are recorded: Sprinturf $460,440.00, remark "Vol Alt (1)"; Astroturf Great Lakes $462,365.00, remark "Vol Alt (2)"; A-Turf, Inc. $477,500.00, remark "Vol Alt (1)"; Shaw Integrated Turf Solutions $515,905.00, remark "Vol Alt (1)"; and Act Global Americas, Inc. $529,927.00. Three additional bidder rows are blank.

**Bid tabulation – Proposal C, Track Surface**
Two base bids are recorded: Goddard Coatings Company $194,105.00 and Star Trac Enterprise, LLC $282,000.00. Five additional bidder rows are blank.

**Bid tabulation – Proposal D, Site Work Track**
Two base bids are recorded: Nagle Paving Company $534,790.00 and Asphalt Specialists, LLC $750,000.00. Five additional bidder rows are blank.

**Closing**
Foresite Design asks the district to advise its office of additional information that may be required from the recommended contractors so that it may be secured on the district's behalf for presentation at the next Board of Education meeting, and invites questions or concerns. The letter functions as the professional recommendation supporting the Board's award of the turf and track renovation contracts for Troy High School and Boulan Park Middle School under RFP 9951TSD.
